parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set services rpm responder.explanation: 启用RPM（Real-time Performance Monitoring）响应器功能。

set services rpm twamp server.explanation: 启用TWAMP（Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol）服务器功能。

set services rpm twamp control-session t.template: set services rpm twamp control-session timeout [parameter1]
set services rpm twamp control-session t.command: set services rpm twamp control-session timeout 600
set services rpm twamp control-session t.explanation: 设置TWAMP控制会话的超时时间。

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.explanation: 控制会话的超时时间，单位为秒。

set services rpm twamp test-session time.template: set services rpm twamp test-session timeout [parameter1]
set services rpm twamp test-session time.command: set services rpm twamp test-session timeout 600
set services rpm twamp test-session time.explanation: 设置TWAMP测试会话的超时时间。

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.explanation: 测试会话的超时时间，单位为秒。

set services rpm twamp server tcp listen.template: set services rpm twamp server tcp listen-mode [parameter1]
set services rpm twamp server tcp listen.command: set services rpm twamp server tcp listen-mode any-ip
set services rpm twamp server tcp listen.explanation: 设置TWAMP服务器TCP监听模式为任意IP。

set services rpm twamp server tcp port 6.template: set services rpm twamp server tcp port [parameter1]
set services rpm twamp server tcp port 6.command: set services rpm twamp server tcp port 65530
